Sixth Man of The Year: 2008 }} '''Omri Casspi''' ({{lang-he|'''עמרי כספי'''}}, born June 22, 1988 in [[Yavne]], [[Israel]]) is a professional [[Israel]]i [[basketball player]]. He is {{convert|6|ft|8.75|in|m|2}} and plays [[small forward (basketball)|small forward]]. He currently plays for the Israeli club [[Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nbadraft.net/players/omri-casspi|title=Omri Casspi|publisher=NBADraft.net|accessdate=2009-06-01}} ==Professional career== Casspi began his career with [[Hapoel Holon]]'s junior teams in [[Holon]], Israel as a youth. He made his professional debut at age 17 with [[Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.|Maccabi Tel Aviv]] during the 2005–06 season. He joined [[Hapoel Galil Elyon]] on-loan during the 2006–07 season and returned to Maccabi in 2007. In a pre-season exhibition game against the [[New York Knicks]] at [[Madison Square Garden]] on October 11, 2007, Casspi started the game and shot three-for-three from the floor, including a three-pointer, for eight points in only sixteen minutes of playing-time.{{cite news |first= |last=[[Associated Press]] |authorlink= |coauthors= |title=Fans give little reaction to Thomas in Knicks' blowout |url=http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/recap?gameId=271011018 |work= |publisher=[[ESPN.com]] |date=2007-10-11 |accessdate=2009-06-23}} On February 18, 2009, Casspi finished in fourth place in voting for the [[FIBA Europe Young Men's Player of the Year Award]] for the 2008-2009 season, behind [[Ricky Rubio]], [[Danilo Gallinari]], and [[Kosta Koufos]]. ==Attempts to Join the NBA== In 2008, Casspi declared himself eligible for the [[2008 NBA Draft]], but he withdrew before the declaration deadline after failing to receive a first-round draft guarantee from any NBA club.{{cite web|url=http://www.jpost.com/servlet/Satellite?cid=1212659760124&pagename=JPost%2FJPArticle%2FShowFull|title=NBA & Local Hoops: Casspi withdraws from draft|last=Sinai|first=Allon|date=2008-06-18|publisher=Jerusalem Post|accessdate=2009-06-01}} In 2009, Casspi again declared himself available for the [[2009 NBA Draft|draft]], and is considered a
